name: Data-Driven Method for Li-Ion Battery Health Monitoring
description: We propose a simple yet effective machine learning framework utilizing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models for SOH prediction, addressing the common issues of high complexity, low interpretability, and high training costs.
